name: Ferienwohnung Gerl
beschreibung:
Quietly situated within Kufstein, Ferienwohnung Gerl provides modern living comfort for city explorers and outdoor enthusiasts alike. The well-kept apartment features a fully equipped kitchen and restful bedrooms.

The historic old town with Kufstein Fortress, the famed Roemerhofgasse, and trailheads into the Kaiser Nature Reserve are quickly accessible.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Gerl in Kufstein offers central and comfortable accommodation in the historic fortress town.
